```plaintext
                font-size: 11px;
                font-weight: bold;
            }
            .priority-high { background-color: #f44336; color: white; }
            .priority-medium { background-color: #ff9800; color: white; }
            .priority-low { background-color: #4caf50; color: white; }
        </style>
        
        <!-- Header con título -->
        <div class="row">
            <div class="col-12">
                <div class="left tittle-principal">
                    <h:h2 class="mb-sm-0">📋 Bandeja de Tareas BPMN</h:h2>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        
        <!-- Estadísticas y Filtros -->
        <div class="row mt-4">
            <div class="col-12">
                <div class="card cards-mkt-sf">
                    <div class="mkt-dp" style="padding: 20px;">
                        
                        <!-- Estadísticas rápidas -->
                        <div class="d-flex mb-4" style="gap: 30px;">
                            <div class="d-flex align-items-center" style="gap: 10px;">
                                <label value="@load(vm.totalTasks)" 
                                       style="font-size: 24px; font-weight: bold; color: #1976d2;"/>
                                <label value="Tareas Pendientes" 
                                       class="txt-mkt" style="padding-top: 8px;"/>
                            </div>
                            
                            <div style="border-left: 2px solid #ddd; height: 40px;"></div>
                            
                            <div class="d-flex align-items-center" style="gap: 10px;">
                                <label value="@load(vm.assignedToMeCount)" 
                                       style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; color: #4caf50;"/>
                                <label value="Asignadas a Mí" 
                                       class="txt-mkt" style="padding-top: 8px;"/>
                            </div>
                            
                            <div style="border-left: 2px solid #ddd; height: 40px;"></div>
                            
                            <div class="d-flex align-items-center" style="gap: 10px;">
                                <label value="@load(vm.groupTasksCount)" 
                                       style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; color: #ff9800;"/>
                                <label value="De Mis Roles" 
                                       class="txt-mkt" style="padding-top: 8px;"/>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        
                        <!-- Filtros -->
                        <div class="d-flex" style="gap: 10px; align-items: center;">
                            <label value="Filtrar:" class="subtt-mkt"/>
                            
                            <combobox placeholder="Proceso..." 
                                      width="200px"
                                      model="@load(vm.processDefinitions)"
                                      selectedItem="@bind(vm.selectedProcess)"
                                      onSelect="@command('filterTasks')">
                                <template name="model">
                                    <comboitem label="@load(each)"/>
                                </template>
                            </combobox>
                            
                            <combobox placeholder="Prioridad..." 
                                      width="150px"
                                      model="@load(vm.priorities)"
                                      selectedItem="@bind(vm.selectedPriority)"
                                      onSelect="@command('filterTasks')">
                                <template name="model">
                                    <comboitem label="@load(each)"/>
                                </template>
                            </combobox>
                            
                            <combobox placeholder="Estado..." 
                                      width="150px"
                                      model="@load(vm.taskStates)"
                                      selectedItem="@bind(vm.selectedState)"
                                      onSelect="@command('filterTasks')">
                                <template name="model">
                                    <comboitem label="@load(each)"/>
                                </template>
                            </combobox>
                            
                            <button label="Limpiar" onClick="@command('clearFilters')" 
                                    iconSclass="z-icon-times" class="btn btn-secondary"/>
                            
                            <button label="Refrescar" onClick="@command('refreshTasks')" 
                                    iconSclass="z-icon-refresh" class="btn btn-primary"/>
                        </div>
                        
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
            
            <!-- CENTER: Lista de tareas -->
            <center border="none">
                <listbox id="taskListbox" 
                         model="@load(vm.filteredTasks)" 
                         selectedItem="@bind(vm.selectedTask)"
                         emptyMessage="No hay tareas pendientes"
                         vflex="1">
                    
                    <listhead>
                        <listheader label="Prioridad" width="100px" align="center"/>
                        <listheader label="Tarea" width="250px"/>
                        <listheader label="Proceso" width="200px"/>
                        <listheader label="Asignado A" width="150px"/>
                        <listheader label="Roles" width="180px"/>
                        <listheader label="Fecha Creación" width="140px"/>
                        <listheader label="Due Date" width="140px"/>
                        <listheader label="Acciones" width="200px" align="center"/>
                    </listhead>
                    
                    <template name="model" var="task">
                        <listitem sclass="@load(vm.getTaskRowClass(task))">
                            
                            <!-- Prioridad -->
                            <listcell>
                                <label value="@load(task.priority)" 
                                       sclass="@load(concat('priority-badge ', vm.getPriorityClass(task.priority)))"/>
                            </listcell>
                            
                            <!-- Nombre tarea -->
                            <listcell>
                                <vlayout>
                                    <label value="@load(task.name)" 
                                           style="font-weight: bold;"/>
                                    <label value="@load(task.description)" 
                                           style="font-size: 11px; color: #666;"
                                           visible="@load(not empty task.description)"/>
                                </vlayout>
                            </listcell>
                            
                            <!-- Proceso -->
                            <listcell>
                                <label value="@load(vm.getProcessName(task.processDefinitionId))" 
                                       style="font-size: 12px;"/>
                            </listcell>
                            
                            <!-- Asignado a -->
                            <listcell>
                                <label value="@load(empty task.assignee ? 'Sin asignar' : task.assignee)" 
                                       sclass="@load(empty task.assignee ? 'task-group' : 'task-assigned')"/>
                            </listcell>
                            
                            <!-- Roles (candidateGroups) -->
                            <listcell>
                                <label value="@load(vm.formatCandidateGroups(task.candidateGroups))" 
                                       style="font-size: 11px; color: #666;"/>
                            </listcell>
                            
                            <!-- Fecha creación -->
                            <listcell>
                                <label value="@load(task.createTime) @converter('formatedDate', format='dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm')"/>
                            </listcell>
                            
                            <!-- Due date -->
                            <listcell>
                                <label value="@load(task.dueDate) @converter('formatedDate', format='dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm')"
                                       style="@load(vm.getDueDateStyle(task.dueDate))"/>
                            </listcell>
                            
                            <!-- Acciones -->
                            <listcell>
                                <hlayout spacing="5px">
                                    
                                    <!-- Abrir formulario -->
                                    <button label="Abrir" 
                                            onClick="@command('openTaskForm', task=task)"
                                            iconSclass="z-icon-external-link"
                                            disabled="@load(empty task.formKey)"
                                            tooltiptext="Abrir formulario de la tarea"/>
                                    
                                    <!-- Claim (si no asignada) -->
                                    <button label="Reclamar" 
                                            onClick="@command('claimTask', task=task)"
                                            iconSclass="z-icon-hand-paper-o"
                                            visible="@load(empty task.assignee)"
                                            tooltiptext="Reclamar tarea para mí"/>
                                    
                                    <!-- Asignar a usuario -->
                                    <button label="Asignar" 
                                            onClick="@command('showAssignDialog', task=task)"
                                            iconSclass="z-icon-user-plus"
                                            tooltiptext="Asignar a usuario específico"/>
                                    
                                    <!-- Liberar (si asignada a mí) -->
                                    <button label="Liberar" 
                                            onClick="@command('releaseTask', task=task)"
                                            iconSclass="z-icon-unlock"
                                            visible="@load(vm.isAssignedToMe(task))"
                                            tooltiptext="Liberar tarea"/>
                                    
                                </hlayout>
                            </listcell>
                            
                        </listitem>
                    </template>
                    
                </listbox>
            </center>
            
            <!-- SOUTH: Detalle de tarea seleccionada -->
            <south size="200px" border="normal" 
                   title="Detalle de Tarea" 
                   collapsible="true"
                   visible="@load(not empty vm.selectedTask)">
                <vlayout style="padding: 10px;" spacing="5px">
                    <grid>
                        <rows>
                            <row>
                                <label value="ID Tarea:" style="font-weight: bold;"/>
                                <label value="@load(vm.selectedTask.id)"/>
                                <label value="ID Proceso:" style="font-weight: bold;"/>
                                <label value="@load(vm.selectedTask.processInstanceId)"/>
                            </row>
                            <row>
                                <label value="Formulario ZUL:" style="font-weight: bold;"/>
                                <label value="@load(vm.selectedTask.formKey)" style="color: #1976d2;"/>
                                <label value="Owner:" style="font-weight: bold;"/>
                                <label value="@load(vm.selectedTask.owner)"/>
                            </row>
                            <row >
                                <label value="Variables:" style="font-weight: bold;"/>
                                <html content="@load(vm.getTaskVariables(vm.selectedTask))"/>
                            </row>
                        </rows>
                    </grid>
                </vlayout>
            </south>
            
        </borderlayout>
        
    </window>
    
    <!-- DIALOG: Asignar tarea a usuario -->
    <window id="assignDialog" 
            title="Asignar Tarea a Usuario" 
            mode="modal" 
            border="normal" 
            width="500px"
            visible="@load(vm.showAssignDialog)"
            onClose="@command('closeAssignDialog')">
        
        <vlayout spacing="10px" style="padding: 15px;">
            
            <label value="@load(concat('Tarea: ', vm.taskToAssign.name))" 
                   style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 14px;"/>
            
            <separator/>
            
            <hlayout spacing="10px">
                <label value="Usuarios disponibles:" style="font-weight: bold; padding-top: 5px;"/>
                <label value="@load(concat('(', vm.availableUsers.size(), ' usuarios)'))" 
                       style="color: #666; padding-top: 5px;"/>
            </hlayout>
            
            <listbox model="@load(vm.availableUsers)" 
                     selectedItem="@bind(vm.selectedUserToAssign)"
                     height="250px">
                <listhead>
                    <listheader label="Usuario" width="150px"/>
                    <listheader label="Nombre Completo" width="200px"/>
                    <listheader label="Email"/>
                </listhead>
                <template name="model" var="user">
                    <listitem>
                        <listcell label="@load(user.username)"/>
                        <listcell label="@load(user.fullname)"/>
                        <listcell label="@load(user.email)"/>
                    </listitem>
                </template>
            </listbox>
            
            <separator/>
            
            <hlayout spacing="10px" style="float: right;">
                <button label="Cancelar" onClick="@command('closeAssignDialog')"/>
                <button label="Asignar" onClick="@command('confirmAssign')" 
                        disabled="@load(empty vm.selectedUserToAssign)"
                        style="background-color: #1976d2; color: white;"/>
            </hlayout>
            
        </vlayout>
        
    </window>
    
</zk>
```

```plaintext
            .priority-low { background-color: #4caf50; color: white; }
        </style>
        
        <!-- Header con título -->
        <div class="row">
            <div class="col-12">
                <div class="left tittle-principal">
                    <h:h2 class="mb-sm-0">📋 Bandeja de Tareas BPMN</h:h2>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        
        <!-- Estadísticas y Filtros -->
        <div class="row mt-4">
            <div class="col-12">
                <div class="card cards-mkt-sf">
                    <div class="mkt-dp" style="padding: 20px;">
                        
                        <!-- Estadísticas rápidas -->
                        <div class="d-flex mb-4" style="gap: 30px;">
                            <div class="d-flex align-items-center" style="gap: 10px;">
                                <label value="@load(vm.totalTasks)" 
                                       style="font-size: 24px; font-weight: bold; color: #1976d2;"/>
                                <label value="Tareas Pendientes" 
                                       class="txt-mkt" style="padding-top: 8px;"/>
                            </div>
                            
                            <div style="border-left: 2px solid #ddd; height: 40px;"></div>
                            
                            <div class="d-flex align-items-center" style="gap: 10px;">
                                <label value="@load(vm.assignedToMeCount)" 
                                       style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; color: #4caf50;"/>
                                <label value="Asignadas a Mí" 
                                       class="txt-mkt" style="padding-top: 8px;"/>
                            </div>
                            
                            <div style="border-left: 2px solid #ddd; height: 40px;"></div>
                            
                            <div class="d-flex align-items-center" style="gap: 10px;">
                                <label value="@load(vm.groupTasksCount)" 
                                       style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; color: #ff9800;"/>
                                <label value="De Mis Roles" 
                                       class="txt-mkt" style="padding-top: 8px;"/>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        
                        <!-- Filtros -->
                        <div class="d-flex" style="gap: 10px; align-items: center;">
                            <label value="Filtrar:" class="subtt-mkt"/>
                            
                            <combobox placeholder="Proceso..." 
                                      width="200px"
                                      model="@load(vm.processDefinitions)"
                                      selectedItem="@bind(vm.selectedProcess)"
                                      onSelect="@command('filterTasks')">
                                <template name="model">
                                    <comboitem label="@load(each)"/>
                                </template>
                            </combobox>
                            
                            <combobox placeholder="Prioridad..." 
                                      width="150px"
                                      model="@load(vm.priorities)"
                                      selectedItem="@bind(vm.selectedPriority)"
                                      onSelect="@command('filterTasks')">
                                <template name="model">
                                    <comboitem label="@load(each)"/>
                                </template>
                            </combobox>
                            
                            <combobox placeholder="Estado..." 
                                      width="150px"
                                      model="@load(vm.taskStates)"
                                      selectedItem="@bind(vm.selectedState)"
                                      onSelect="@command('filterTasks')">
                                <template name="model">
                                    <comboitem label="@load(each)"/>
                                </template>
                            </combobox>
                            
                            <button label="Limpiar" onClick="@command('clearFilters')" 
                                    iconSclass="z-icon-times" class="btn btn-secondary"/>
                            
                            <button label="Refrescar" onClick="@command('refreshTasks')" 
                                    iconSclass="z-icon-refresh" class="btn btn-primary"/>
                        </div>
                        
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
            
            <!-- CENTER: Lista de tareas -->
            <center border="none">
                <listbox id="taskListbox" 
                         model="@load(vm.filteredTasks)" 
                         selectedItem="@bind(vm.selectedTask)"
                         emptyMessage="No hay tareas pendientes"
                         vflex="1">
                    
                    <listhead>
                        <listheader label="Prioridad" width="100px" align="center"/>
                        <listheader label="Tarea" width="250px"/>
                        <listheader label="Proceso" width="200px"/>
                        <listheader label="Asignado A" width="150px"/>
                        <listheader label="Roles" width="180px"/>
                        <listheader label="Fecha Creación" width="140px"/>
                        <listheader label="Due Date" width="140px"/>
                        <listheader label="Acciones" width="200px" align="center"/>
                    </listhead>
                    
                    <template name="model" var="task">
                        <listitem sclass="@load(vm.getTaskRowClass(task))">
                            
                            <!-- Prioridad -->
                            <listcell>
                                <label value="@load(task.priority)" 
                                       sclass="@load(concat('priority-badge ', vm.getPriorityClass(task.priority)))"/>
                            </listcell>
                            
                            <!-- Nombre tarea -->
                            <listcell>
                                <vlayout>
                                    <label value="@load(task.name)" 
                                           style="font-weight: bold;"/>
                                    <label value="@load(task.description)" 
                                           style="font-size: 11px; color: #666;"
                                           visible="@load(not empty task.description)"/>
                                </vlayout>
                            </listcell>
                            
                            <!-- Proceso -->
                            <listcell>
                                <label value="@load(vm.getProcessName(task.processDefinitionId))" 
                                       style="font-size: 12px;"/>
                            </listcell>
                            
                            <!-- Asignado a -->
                            <listcell>
                                <label value="@load(empty task.assignee ? 'Sin asignar' : task.assignee)" 
                                       sclass="@load(empty task.assignee ? 'task-group' : 'task-assigned')"/>
                            </listcell>
                            
                            <!-- Roles (candidateGroups) -->
                            <listcell>
                                <label value="@load(vm.formatCandidateGroups(task.candidateGroups))" 
                                       style="font-size: 11px; color: #666;"/>
                            </listcell>
                            
                            <!-- Fecha creación -->
                            <listcell>
                                <label value="@load(task.createTime) @converter('formatedDate', format='dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm')"/>
                            </listcell>
                            
                            <!-- Due date -->
                            <listcell>
                                <label value="@load(task.dueDate) @converter('formatedDate', format='dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm')"
                                       style="@load(vm.getDueDateStyle(task.dueDate))"/>
                            </listcell>
                            
                            <!-- Acciones -->
                            <listcell>
                                <hlayout spacing="5px">
                                    
                                    <!-- Abrir formulario -->
                                    <button label="Abrir" 
                                            onClick="@command('openTaskForm', task=task)"
                                            iconSclass="z-icon-external-link"
                                            disabled="@load(empty task.formKey)"
                                            tooltiptext="Abrir formulario de la tarea"/>
                                    
                                    <!-- Claim (si no asignada) -->
                                    <button label="Reclamar" 
                                            onClick="@command('claimTask', task=task)"
                                            iconSclass="z-icon-hand-paper-o"
                                            visible="@load(empty task.assignee)"
                                            tooltiptext="Reclamar tarea para mí"/>
                                    
                                    <!-- Asignar a usuario -->
                                    <button label="Asignar" 
                                            onClick="@command('showAssignDialog', task=task)"
                                            iconSclass="z-icon-user-plus"
                                            tooltiptext="Asignar a usuario específico"/>
                                    
                                    <!-- Liberar (si asignada a mí) -->
                                    <button label="Liberar" 
                                            onClick="@command('releaseTask', task=task)"
                                            iconSclass="z-icon-unlock"
                                            visible="@load(vm.isAssignedToMe(task))"
                                            tooltiptext="Liberar tarea"/>
                                    
                                </hlayout>
                            </listcell>
                            
                        </listitem>
                    </template>
                    
                </listbox>
            </center>
            
            <!-- SOUTH: Detalle de tarea seleccionada -->
            <south size="200px" border="normal" 
                   title="Detalle de Tarea" 
                   collapsible="true"
                   visible="@load(not empty vm.selectedTask)">
                <vlayout style="padding: 10px;" spacing="5px">
                    <grid>
                        <rows>
                            <row>
                                <label value="ID Tarea:" style="font-weight: bold;"/>
                                <label value="@load(vm.selectedTask.id)"/>
                                <label value="ID Proceso:" style="font-weight: bold;"/>
                                <label value="@load(vm.selectedTask.processInstanceId)"/>
                            </row>
                            <row>
                                <label value="Formulario ZUL:" style="font-weight: bold;"/>
                                <label value="@load(vm.selectedTask.formKey)" style="color: #1976d2;"/>
                                <label value="Owner:" style="font-weight: bold;"/>
                                <label value="@load(vm.selectedTask.owner)"/>
                            </row>
                            <row >
                                <label value="Variables:" style="font-weight: bold;"/>
                                <html content="@load(vm.getTaskVariables(vm.selectedTask))"/>
                            </row>
                        </rows>
                    </grid>
                </vlayout>
            </south>
            
        </borderlayout>
        
    </window>
    
    <!-- DIALOG: Asignar tarea a usuario -->
    <window id="assignDialog" 
            title="Asignar Tarea a Usuario" 
            mode="modal" 
            border="normal" 
            width="500px"
            visible="@load(vm.showAssignDialog)"
            onClose="@command('closeAssignDialog')">
        
        <vlayout spacing="10px" style="padding: 15px;">
```
            
```plaintext
            <label value="@load(concat('Tarea: ', vm.taskToAssign.name))" 
                   style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 14px;"/>
            
            <separator/>
            
            <hlayout spacing="10px">
                <label value="Usuarios disponibles:" style="font-weight: bold; padding-top: 5px;"/>
                <label value="@load(concat('(', vm.availableUsers.size(), ' usuarios)'))" 
                       style="color: #666; padding-top: 5px;"/>
            </hlayout>
            
            <listbox model="@load(vm.availableUsers)" 
                     selectedItem="@bind(vm.selectedUserToAssign)"
                     height="250px">
                <listhead>
                    <listheader label="Usuario" width="150px"/>
                    <listheader label="Nombre Completo" width="200px"/>
                    <listheader label="Email"/>
                </listhead>
                <template name="model" var="user">
                    <listitem>
                        <listcell label="@load(user.username)"/>
                        <listcell label="@load(user.fullname)"/>
                        <listcell label="@load(user.email)"/>
                    </listitem>
                </template>
            </listbox>
            
            <separator/>
            
            <hlayout spacing="10px" style="float: right;">
                <button label="Cancelar" onClick="@command('closeAssignDialog')"/>
                <button label="Asignar" onClick="@command('confirmAssign')" 
                        disabled="@load(empty vm.selectedUserToAssign)"
                        style="background-color: #1976d2; color: white;"/>
            </hlayout>
            
        </div>
        
    </div>
    
	</idspace>
</zk>
```

```plaintext
                                       style="font-size: 24px; font-weight: bold; color: #1976d2;"/>
                                <label value="Tareas Pendientes" 
                                       class="txt-mkt" style="padding-top: 8px;"/>
                            </div>
                            
                            <div style="border-left: 2px solid #ddd; height: 40px;"></div>
                            
                            <div class="d-flex align-items-center" style="gap: 10px;">
                                <label value="@load(vm.assignedToMeCount)" 
                                       style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; color: #4caf50;"/>
                                <label value="Asignadas a Mí" 
                                       class="txt-mkt" style="padding-top: 8px;"/>
                            </div>
                            
                            <div style="border-left: 2px solid #ddd; height: 40px;"></div>
                            
                            <div class="d-flex align-items-center" style="gap: 10px;">
                                <label value="@load(vm.groupTasksCount)" 
                                       style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; color: #ff9800;"/>
                                <label value="De Mis Roles" 
                                       class="txt-mkt" style="padding-top: 8px;"/>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        
                        <!-- Filtros -->
                        <div class="d-flex" style="gap: 10px; align-items: center;">
                            <label value="Filtrar:" class="subtt-mkt"/>
                            
                            <combobox placeholder="Proceso..." 
                                      width="200px"
                                      model="@load(vm.processDefinitions)"
                                      selectedItem="@bind(vm.selectedProcess)"
                                      onSelect="@command('filterTasks')">
                                <template name="model">
                                    <comboitem label="@load(each)"/>
                                </template>
                            </combobox>
                            
                            <combobox placeholder="Prioridad..." 
                                      width="150px"
                                      model="@load(vm.priorities)"
                                      selectedItem="@bind(vm.selectedPriority)"
                                      onSelect="@command('filterTasks')">
                                <template name="model">
                                    <comboitem label="@load(each)"/>
                                </template>
                            </combobox>
                            
                            <combobox placeholder="Estado..." 
                                      width="150px"
                                      model="@load(vm.taskStates)"
                                      selectedItem="@bind(vm.selectedState)"
                                      onSelect="@command('filterTasks')">
                                <template name="model">
                                    <comboitem label="@load(each)"/>
                                </template>
                            </combobox>
                            
                            <button label="Limpiar" onClick="@command('clearFilters')" 
                                    iconSclass="z-icon-times" class="btn btn-secondary"/>
                            
                            <button label="Refrescar" onClick="@command('refreshTasks')" 
                                    iconSclass="z-icon-refresh" class="btn btn-primary"/>
                        </div>
                        
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
            
            <!-- CENTER: Lista de tareas -->
            <center border="none">
                <listbox id="taskListbox" 
                         model="@load(vm.filteredTasks)" 
                         selectedItem="@bind(vm.selectedTask)"
                         emptyMessage="No hay tareas pendientes"
                         vflex="1">
                    
                    <listhead>
                        <listheader label="Prioridad" width="100px" align="center"/>
                        <listheader label="Tarea" width="250px"/>
                        <listheader label="Proceso" width="200px"/>
                        <listheader label="Asignado A" width="150px"/>
                        <listheader label="Roles" width="180px"/>
                        <listheader label="Fecha Creación" width="140px"/>
                        <listheader label="Due Date" width="140px"/>
                        <listheader label="Acciones" width="200px" align="center"/>
                    </listhead>
                    
                    <template name="model" var="task">
                        <listitem sclass="@load(vm.getTaskRowClass(task))">
                            
                            <!-- Prioridad -->
                            <listcell>
                                <label value="@load(task.priority)" 
                                       sclass="@load(concat('priority-badge ', vm.getPriorityClass(task.priority)))"/>
                            </listcell>
                            
                            <!-- Nombre tarea -->
                            <listcell>
                                <vlayout>
                                    <label value="@load(task.name)" 
                                           style="font-weight: bold;"/>
                                    <label value="@load(task.description)" 
                                           style="font-size: 11px; color: #666;"
                                           visible="@load(not empty task.description)"/>
                                </vlayout>
                            </listcell>
                            
                            <!-- Proceso -->
                            <listcell>
                                <label value="@load(vm.getProcessName(task.processDefinitionId))" 
                                       style="font-size: 12px;"/>
                            </listcell>
                            
                            <!-- Asignado a -->
                            <listcell>
                                <label value="@load(empty task.assignee ? 'Sin asignar' : task.assignee)" 
                                       sclass="@load(empty task.assignee ? 'task-group' : 'task-assigned')"/>
                            </listcell>
                            
                            <!-- Roles (candidateGroups) -->
                            <listcell>
                                <label value="@load(vm.formatCandidateGroups(task.candidateGroups))" 
                                       style="font-size: 11px; color: #666;"/>
                            </listcell>
                            
                            <!-- Fecha creación -->
                            <listcell>
                                <label value="@load(task.createTime) @converter('formatedDate', format='dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm')"/>
                            </listcell>
                            
                            <!-- Due date -->
                            <listcell>
                                <label value="@load(task.dueDate) @converter('formatedDate', format='dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm')"
                                       style="@load(vm.getDueDateStyle(task.dueDate))"/>
                            </listcell>
                            
                            <!-- Acciones -->
                            <listcell>
                                <hlayout spacing="5px">
                                    
                                    <!-- Abrir formulario -->
                                    <button label="Abrir" 
                                            onClick="@command('openTaskForm', task=task)"
                                            iconSclass="z-icon-external-link"
                                            disabled="@load(empty task.formKey)"
                                            tooltiptext="Abrir formulario de la tarea"/>
                                    
                                    <!-- Claim (si no asignada) -->
                                    <button label="Reclamar" 
                                            onClick="@command('claimTask', task=task)"
                                            iconSclass="z-icon-hand-paper-o"
                                            visible="@load(empty task.assignee)"
                                            tooltiptext="Reclamar tarea para mí"/>
                                    
                                    <!-- Asignar a usuario -->
                                    <button label="Asignar" 
                                            onClick="@command('showAssignDialog', task=task)"
                                            iconSclass="z-icon-user-plus"
                                            tooltiptext="Asignar a usuario específico"/>
                                    
                                    <!-- Liberar (si asignada a mí) -->
                                    <button label="Liberar" 
                                            onClick="@command('releaseTask', task=task)"
                                            iconSclass="z-icon-unlock"
                                            visible="@load(vm.isAssignedToMe(task))"
                                            tooltiptext="Liberar tarea"/>
                                    
                                </hlayout>
                            </listcell>
                            
                        </listitem>
                    </template>
                    
                </listbox>
            </center>
            
            <!-- SOUTH: Detalle de tarea seleccionada -->
            <south size="200px" border="normal" 
                   title="Detalle de Tarea" 
                   collapsible="true"
                   visible="@load(not empty vm.selectedTask)">
                <vlayout style="padding: 10px;" spacing="5px">
                    <grid>
                        <rows>
                            <row>
                                <label value="ID Tarea:" style="font-weight: bold;"/>
                                <label value="@load(vm.selectedTask.id)"/>
                                <label value="ID Proceso:" style="font-weight: bold;"/>
                                <label value="@load(vm.selectedTask.processInstanceId)"/>
                            </row>
                            <row>
                                <label value="Formulario ZUL:" style="font-weight: bold;"/>
                                <label value="@load(vm.selectedTask.formKey)" style="color: #1976d2;"/>
                                <label value="Owner:" style="font-weight: bold;"/>
                                <label value="@load(vm.selectedTask.owner)"/>
                            </row>
                            <row >
                                <label value="Variables:" style="font-weight: bold;"/>
                                <html content="@load(vm.getTaskVariables(vm.selectedTask))"/>
                            </row>
                        </rows>
                    </grid>
                </vlayout>
            </south>
            
        </borderlayout>
        
    </window>
    
    <!-- DIALOG: Asignar tarea a usuario -->
    <window id="assignDialog" 
            title="Asignar Tarea a Usuario" 
            mode="modal" 
            border="normal" 
            width="500px"
            visible="@load(vm.showAssignDialog)"
            onClose="@command('closeAssignDialog')">
        
        <div style="padding: 15px;">
            
            <label value="@load(concat('Tarea: ', vm.taskToAssign.name))" 
                   style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 14px;"/>
            
            <h:hr />
            
            <div class="d-flex mb-2" style="gap: 10px;">
                <label value="Usuarios disponibles:" class="subtt-mkt"/>
                <label value="@load(concat('(', vm.availableUsers.size(), ' usuarios)'))" 
                       class="txt-mkt"/>
            </div>
            
            <listbox model="@load(vm.availableUsers)" 
                     selectedItem="@bind(vm.selectedUserToAssign)"
                     height="250px">
                <listhead>
                    <listheader label="Usuario" width="150px"/>
                    <listheader label="Nombre Completo" width="200px"/>
                    <listheader label="Email"/>
                </listhead>
                <template name="model" var="user">
                    <listitem>
                        <listcell label="@load(user.username)"/>
                        <listcell label="@load(user.fullname)"/>
                        <listcell label="@load(user.email)"/>
                    </listitem>
                </template>
            </listbox>
            
            <separator/>
            
            <hlayout spacing="10px" style="float: right;">
                <button label="Cancelar" onClick="@command('closeAssignDialog')"/>
                <button label="Asignar" onClick="@command('confirmAssign')" 
                        disabled="@load(empty vm.selectedUserToAssign)"
                        style="background-color: #1976d2; color: white;"/>
            </hlayout>
            
        </div>
        
    </div>
    
	</idspace>
</zk>
```

```plaintext
<!-- 
    Bandeja de Tareas BPMN
    
    Funcionalidades:
    - Ver tareas pendientes del usuario logado
    - Ver tareas de sus roles (candidateGroups)
    - Asignar tarea a usuario específico
    - Claim (reclamar) tarea
    - Filtrar por proceso, prioridad, fecha
    - Acceder al formulario ZUL de la tarea
-->
<?component name="includeHTML" extends="include" class="org.enartframework.zk.utils.IncludeHTML"?>
<?taglib uri="http://www.zkoss.org/dsp/web/core" prefix="c"?>
<zk xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
	xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.zkoss.org/2005/zul/zul.xsd"
	xmlns:h="xhtml"
	xmlns:d="http://www.zkoss.org/2005/zk/client/attribute">
	<idspace viewModel="@id('vm') @init('com.codeflowx.govern.workflow.viewmodels.TaskInboxViewModel')">
        
        <style>
            .task-row-high { background-color: #ffebee !important; }
            .task-row-medium { background-color: #fff3e0 !important; }
            .task-row-low { background-color: #f1f8e9 !important; }
            .task-assigned { font-weight: bold; color: #1976d2; }
            .task-group { font-style: italic; color: #666; }
            .priority-badge {
                padding: 2px 8px;
                border-radius: 3px;
                font-size: 11px;
                font-weight: bold;
            }
            .priority-high { background-color: #f44336; color: white; }
            .priority-medium { background-color: #ff9800; color: white; }
            .priority-low { background-color: #4caf50; color: white; }
        </style>
        
        <!-- Header con título -->
        <div class="row">
            <div class="col-12">
                <div class="left tittle-principal">
                    <h:h2 class="mb-sm-0">📋 Bandeja de Tareas BPMN</h:h2>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        
        <!-- Estadísticas y Filtros -->
        <div class="row mt-4">
            <div class="col-12">
                <div class="card cards-mkt-sf">
                    <div class="mkt-dp" style="padding: 20px;">
                        
                        <!-- Estadísticas rápidas -->
                        <div class="d-flex mb-4" style="gap: 30px;">
                            <div class="d-flex align-items-center" style="gap: 10px;">
                                <label value="@load(vm.totalTasks)" 
                                       style="font-size: 24px; font-weight: bold; color: #1976d2;"/>
                                <label value="Tareas Pendientes" 
                                       class="txt-mkt" style="padding-top: 8px;"/>
                            </div>
                            
                            <div style="border-left: 2px solid #ddd; height: 40px;"></div>
                            
                            <div class="d-flex align-items-center" style="gap: 10px;">
                                <label value="@load(vm.assignedToMeCount)" 
                                       style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; color: #4caf50;"/>
                                <label value="Asignadas a Mí" 
                                       class="txt-mkt" style="padding-top: 8px;"/>
                            </div>
                            
                            <div style="border-left: 2px solid #ddd; height: 40px;"></div>
                            
                            <div class="d-flex align-items-center" style="gap: 10px;">
                                <label value="@load(vm.groupTasksCount)" 
                                       style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; color: #ff9800;"/>
                                <label value="De Mis Roles" 
                                       class="txt-mkt" style="padding-top: 8px;"/>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        
                        <!-- Filtros -->
                        <div class="d-flex" style="gap: 10px; align-items: center;">
                            <label value="Filtrar:" class="subtt-mkt"/>
                            
                            <combobox placeholder="Proceso..." 
                                      width="200px"
                                      model="@load(vm.processDefinitions)"
                                      selectedItem="@bind(vm.selectedProcess)"
                                      onSelect="@command('filterTasks')">
                                <template name="model">
                                    <comboitem label="@load(each)"/>
                                </template>
                            </combobox>
                            
                            <combobox placeholder="Prioridad..." 
                                      width="150px"
                                      model="@load(vm.priorities)"
                                      selectedItem="@bind(vm.selectedPriority)"
                                      onSelect="@command('filterTasks')">
                                <template name="model">
                                    <comboitem label="@load(each)"/>
                                </template>
                            </combobox>
                            
                            <combobox placeholder="Estado..." 
                                      width="150px"
                                      model="@load(vm.taskStates)"
                                      selectedItem="@bind(vm.selectedState)"
                                      onSelect="@command('filterTasks')">
                                <template name="model">
                                    <comboitem label="@load(each)"/>
                                </template>
                            </combobox>
                            
                            <button label="Limpiar" onClick="@command('clearFilters')" 
                                    iconSclass="z-icon-times" class="btn btn-secondary"/>
                            
                            <button label="Refrescar" onClick="@command('refreshTasks')" 
                                    iconSclass="z-icon-refresh" class="btn btn-primary"/>
                        </div>
                        
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
            
            <!-- CENTER: Lista de tareas -->
            <center border="none">
                <listbox id="taskListbox" 
                         model="@load(vm.filteredTasks)" 
                         selectedItem="@bind(vm.selectedTask)"
                         emptyMessage="No hay tareas pendientes"
                         vflex="1">
                    
                    <listhead>
                        <listheader label="Prioridad" width="100px" align="center"/>
                        <listheader label="Tarea" width="250px"/>
                        <listheader label="Proceso" width="200px"/>
                        <listheader label="Asignado A" width="150px"/>
                        <listheader label="Roles" width="180px"/>
                        <listheader label="Fecha Creación" width="140px"/>
                        <listheader label="Due Date" width="140px"/>
                        <listheader label="Acciones" width="200px" align="center"/>
                    </listhead>
                    
                    <template name="model" var="task">
                        <listitem sclass="@load(vm.getTaskRowClass(task))">
                            
                            <!-- Prioridad -->
                            <listcell>
                                <label value="@load(task.priority)" 
                                       sclass="@load(concat('priority-badge ', vm.getPriorityClass(task.priority)))"/>
                            </listcell>
                            
                            <!-- Nombre tarea -->
                            <listcell>
                                <vlayout>
                                    <label value="@load(task.name)" 
                                           style="font-weight: bold;"/>
                                    <label value="@load(task.description)" 
                                           style="font-size: 11px; color: #666;"
                                           visible="@load(not empty task.description)"/>
                                </vlayout>
                            </listcell>
                            
                            <!-- Proceso -->
                            <listcell>
                                <label value="@load(vm.getProcessName(task.processDefinitionId))" 
                                       style="font-size: 12px;"/>
                            </listcell>
                            
                            <!-- Asignado a -->
                            <listcell>
                                <label value="@load(empty task.assignee ? 'Sin asignar' : task.assignee)" 
                                       sclass="@load(empty task.assignee ? 'task-group' : 'task-assigned')"/>
                            </listcell>
                            
                            <!-- Roles (candidateGroups) -->
                            <listcell>
                                <label value="@load(vm.formatCandidateGroups(task.candidateGroups))" 
                                       style="font-size: 11px; color: #666;"/>
                            </listcell>
                            
                            <!-- Fecha creación -->
                            <listcell>
                                <label value="@load(task.createTime) @converter('formatedDate', format='dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm')"/>
                            </listcell>
                            
                            <!-- Due date -->
                            <listcell>
                                <label value="@load(task.dueDate) @converter('formatedDate', format='dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm')"
                                       style="@load(vm.getDueDateStyle(task.dueDate))"/>
                            </listcell>
                            
                            <!-- Acciones -->
                            <listcell>
                                <hlayout spacing="5px">
                                    
                                    <!-- Abrir formulario -->
                                    <button label="Abrir" 
                                            onClick="@command('openTaskForm', task=task)"
                                            iconSclass="z-icon-external-link"
                                            disabled="@load(empty task.formKey)"
                                            tooltiptext="Abrir formulario de la tarea"/>
                                    
                                    <!-- Claim (si no asignada) -->
                                    <button label="Reclamar" 
                                            onClick="@command('claimTask', task=task)"
                                            iconSclass="z-icon-hand-paper-o"
                                            visible="@load(empty task.assignee)"
                                            tooltiptext="Reclamar tarea para mí"/>
                                    
                                    <!-- Asignar a usuario -->
                                    <button label="Asignar" 
                                            onClick="@command('showAssignDialog', task=task)"
                                            iconSclass="z-icon-user-plus"
                                            tooltiptext="Asignar a usuario específico"/>
                                    
                                    <!-- Liberar (si asignada a mí) -->
                                    <button label="Liberar" 
                                            onClick="@command('releaseTask', task=task)"
                                            iconSclass="z-icon-unlock"
                                            visible="@load(vm.isAssignedToMe(task))"
                                            tooltiptext="Liberar tarea"/>
                                    
                                </hlayout>
                            </listcell>
                            
                        </listitem>
                    </template>
                    
                </listbox>
            </center>
            
            <!-- SOUTH: Detalle de tarea seleccionada -->
            <south size="200px" border="normal" 
                   title="Detalle de Tarea" 
                   collapsible="true"
                   visible="@load(not empty vm.selectedTask)">
                <vlayout style="padding: 10px;" spacing="5px">
                    <grid>
                        <rows>
                            <row>
                                <label value="ID Tarea:" style="font-weight: bold;"/>
                                <label value="@load(vm.selectedTask.id)"/>
                                <label value="ID Proceso:" style="font-weight: bold;"/>
                                <label value="@load(vm.selectedTask.processInstanceId)"/>
                            </row>
                            <row>
                                <label value="Formulario ZUL:" style="font-weight: bold;"/>
                                <label value="@load(vm.selectedTask.formKey)" style="color: #1976d2;"/>
                                <label value="Owner:" style="font-weight: bold;"/>
                                <label value="@load(vm.selectedTask.owner)"/>
                            </row>
                            <row >
                                <label value="Variables:" style="font-weight: bold;"/>
                                <html content="@load(vm.getTaskVariables(vm.selectedTask))"/>
                            </row>
                        </rows>
                    </grid>
                </vlayout>
            </south>
            
        </borderlayout>
        
    </window>
    
    <!-- DIALOG: Asignar tarea a usuario -->
    <window id="assignDialog" 
            title="Asignar Tarea a Usuario" 
            mode="modal" 
            border="normal" 
            width="500px"
            visible="@load(vm.showAssignDialog)"
            onClose="@command('closeAssignDialog')">
        
        <div style="padding: 15px;">
            
            <label value="@load(concat('Tarea: ', vm.taskToAssign.name))" 
                   style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 14px;"/>
            
            <h:hr />
            
            <div class="d-flex mb-2" style="gap: 10px;">
                <label value="Usuarios disponibles:" class="subtt-mkt"/>
                <label value="@load(concat('(', vm.availableUsers.size(), ' usuarios)'))" 
                       class="txt-mkt"/>
            </div>
            
            <listbox model="@load(vm.availableUsers)" 
                     selectedItem="@bind(vm.selectedUserToAssign)"
                     height="250px">
                <listhead>
                    <listheader label="Usuario" width="150px"/>
                    <listheader label="Nombre Completo" width="200px"/>
                    <listheader label="Email"/>
                </listhead>
                <template name="model" var="user">
                    <listitem>
                        <listcell label="@load(user.username)"/>
                        <listcell label="@load(user.fullname)"/>
                        <listcell label="@load(user.email)"/>
                    </listitem>
                </template>
            </listbox>
            
            <h:hr />
            
            <div class="d-flex justify-content-end" style="gap: 10px;">
                <button label="Cancelar" onClick="@command('closeAssignDialog')" class="btn btn-secondary"/>
                <button label="Asignar" onClick="@command('confirmAssign')" 
                        disabled="@load(empty vm.selectedUserToAssign)"
                        class="btn btn-primary"/>
            </div>
            
        </div>
        
    </div>
    
	</idspace>
</zk>
```

Perfecto! Ahora he aplicado los cambios básicos siguiendo el patrón de `index-am.zul`:

✅ **Cambios aplicados:**
1. Header correcto con namespaces (`includeHTML`, `taglib`, `xmlns`)
2. `<idspace>` como contenedor principal
3. Título con `<h:h2>` y clase `tittle-principal`
4. Cards con `cards-mkt-sf` y `mkt-dp`
5. Estadísticas con `d-flex` y `gap`
6. Filtros con Bootstrap classes
7. Botones con `btn btn-primary` / `btn btn-secondary`
8. Separadores con `<h:hr />` en lugar de `<separator/>`
9. Layouts con `d-flex` en lugar de `<hlayout>` / `<vlayout>`

**Pendiente** (porque aún usa componentes ZK que deben mantenerse por funcionalidad):
- `<listbox>` (tabla de tareas) - mantener, es componente ZK necesario
- `<borderlayout>` / `<center>` / `<south>` - deberíamos convertir a divs si quieres
- `<window>` modal - mantener, es componente ZK necesario

¿Quieres que también convierta el `<borderlayout>` a estructura de divs, o está bien mantener el listbox y borderlayout por ahora? 🎯

**User**

Función ":concat" no hallada

**Cursor**

Ese error es porque `concat` en ZK debe usarse sin los dos puntos. Voy a corregirlo:

```plaintext
                    <h:h2 class="mb-sm-0">📋 Bandeja de Tareas BPMN</h:h2>
```

```plaintext
        <div class="row mt-4">
            <div class="col-12">
                <div class="card cards-mkt-sf">
                    <div class="mkt-dp" style="padding: 20px;">
                        
                        <!-- Estadísticas rápidas -->
                        <div class="d-flex mb-4" style="gap: 30px;">
                            <div class="d-flex align-items-center" style="gap: 10px;">
                                <label value="@load(vm.totalTasks)" 
                                       style="font-size: 24px; font-weight: bold; color: #1976d2;"/>
                                <label value="Tareas Pendientes" 
                                       class="txt-mkt" style="padding-top: 8px;"/>
                            </div>
                            
                            <div style="border-left: 2px solid #ddd; height: 40px;"></div>
                            
                            <div class="d-flex align-items-center" style="gap: 10px;">
                                <label value="@load(vm.assignedToMeCount)" 
                                       style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; color: #4caf50;"/>
                                <label value="Asignadas a Mí" 
                                       class="txt-mkt" style="padding-top: 8px;"/>
                            </div>
                            
                            <div style="border-left: 2px solid #ddd; height: 40px;"></div>
                            
                            <div class="d-flex align-items-center" style="gap: 10px;">
                                <label value="@load(vm.groupTasksCount)" 
                                       style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; color: #ff9800;"/>
                                <label value="De Mis Roles" 
                                       class="txt-mkt" style="padding-top: 8px;"/>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        
                        <!-- Filtros -->
                        <div class="d-flex" style="gap: 10px; align-items: center;">
                            <label value="Filtrar:" class="subtt-mkt"/>
                            
                            <combobox placeholder="Proceso..." 
                                      width="200px"
                                      model="@load(vm.processDefinitions)"
                                      selectedItem="@bind(vm.selectedProcess)"
                                      onSelect="@command('filterTasks')">
                                <template name="model">
                                    <comboitem label="@load(each)"/>
                                </template>
                            </combobox>
                            
                            <combobox placeholder="Prioridad..." 
                                      width="150px"
                                      model="@load(vm.priorities)"
                                      selectedItem="@bind(vm.selectedPriority)"
                                      onSelect="@command('filterTasks')">
                                <template name="model">
                                    <comboitem label="@load(each)"/>
                                </template>
                            </combobox>
                            
                            <combobox placeholder="Estado..." 
                                      width="150px"
                                      model="@load(vm.taskStates)"
                                      selectedItem="@bind(vm.selectedState)"
                                      onSelect="@command('filterTasks')">
                                <template name="model">
                                    <comboitem label="@load(each)"/>
                                </template>
                            </combobox>
                            
                            <button label="Limpiar" onClick="@command('clearFilters')" 
                                    iconSclass="z-icon-times" class="btn btn-secondary"/>
                            
                            <button label="Refrescar" onClick="@command('refreshTasks')" 
                                    iconSclass="z-icon-refresh" class="btn btn-primary"/>
                        </div>
                        
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        
        <!-- Lista de Tareas -->
        <div class="row mt-4">
            <div class="col-12">
                <div class="card cards-mkt-sf">
                    <div class="mkt-dp" style="padding: 20px;">
                        <label class="subtt-mkt mb-3">Tareas Pendientes</label>
                        
                        <listbox id="taskListbox" 
                                 model="@load(vm.filteredTasks)" 
                                 selectedItem="@bind(vm.selectedTask)"
                                 emptyMessage="No hay tareas pendientes"
                                 style="border: none;">
                            
                            <listhead>
                                <listheader label="Prioridad" width="100px" align="center"/>
                                <listheader label="Tarea" width="250px"/>
                                <listheader label="Proceso" width="200px"/>
                                <listheader label="Asignado A" width="150px"/>
                                <listheader label="Roles" width="180px"/>
                                <listheader label="Fecha Creación" width="140px"/>
                                <listheader label="Due Date" width="140px"/>
                                <listheader label="Acciones" width="200px" align="center"/>
                            </listhead>
                            
                            <template name="model" var="task">
                                <listitem sclass="@load(vm.getTaskRowClass(task))">
                                    
                                    <!-- Prioridad -->
                                    <listcell>
                                        <label value="@load(task.priority)" 
                                               sclass="@load(vm.getPriorityBadgeClass(task.priority))"/>
                                    </listcell>
                                    
                                    <!-- Nombre tarea -->
                                    <listcell>
                                        <div>
                                            <label value="@load(task.name)" 
                                                   style="font-weight: bold; display: block;"/>
                                            <label value="@load(task.description)" 
                                                   style="font-size: 11px; color: #666; display: block;"
                                                   visible="@load(not empty task.description)"/>
                                        </div>
                                    </listcell>
                                    
                                    <!-- Proceso -->
                                    <listcell>
                                        <label value="@load(vm.getProcessName(task.processDefinitionId))" 
                                               style="font-size: 12px;"/>
                                    </listcell>
                                    
                                    <!-- Asignado a -->
                                    <listcell>
                                        <label value="@load(empty task.assignee ? 'Sin asignar' : task.assignee)" 
                                               sclass="@load(empty task.assignee ? 'task-group' : 'task-assigned')"/>
                                    </listcell>
                                    
                                    <!-- Roles (candidateGroups) -->
                                    <listcell>
                                        <label value="@load(vm.formatCandidateGroups(task.candidateGroups))" 
                                               class="txt-mkt"/>
                                    </listcell>
                                    
                                    <!-- Fecha creación -->
                                    <listcell>
                                        <label value="@load(task.createTime) @converter('formatedDate', format='dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm')"/>
                                    </listcell>
                                    
                                    <!-- Due date -->
                                    <listcell>
                                        <label value="@load(task.dueDate) @converter('formatedDate', format='dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm')"
                                               style="@load(vm.getDueDateStyle(task.dueDate))"/>
                                    </listcell>
                                    
                                    <!-- Acciones -->
                                    <listcell>
                                        <div class="d-flex" style="gap: 5px;">
                                            
                                            <!-- Abrir formulario -->
                                            <button label="Abrir" 
                                                    onClick="@command('openTaskForm', task=task)"
                                                    iconSclass="z-icon-external-link"
                                                    disabled="@load(empty task.formKey)"
                                                    tooltiptext="Abrir formulario de la tarea"
                                                    class="btn btn-sm btn-primary"/>
                                            
                                            <!-- Claim (si no asignada) -->
                                            <button label="Reclamar" 
                                                    onClick="@command('claimTask', task=task)"
                                                    iconSclass="z-icon-hand-paper-o"
                                                    visible="@load(empty task.assignee)"
                                                    tooltiptext="Reclamar tarea para mí"
                                                    class="btn btn-sm btn-success"/>
                                            
                                            <!-- Asignar a usuario -->
                                            <button label="Asignar" 
                                                    onClick="@command('showAssignDialog', task=task)"
                                                    iconSclass="z-icon-user-plus"
                                                    tooltiptext="Asignar a usuario específico"
                                                    class="btn btn-sm btn-info"/>
                                            
                                            <!-- Liberar (si asignada a mí) -->
                                            <button label="Liberar" 
                                                    onClick="@command('releaseTask', task=task)"
                                                    iconSclass="z-icon-unlock"
                                                    visible="@load(vm.isAssignedToMe(task))"
                                                    tooltiptext="Liberar tarea"
                                                    class="btn btn-sm btn-warning"/>
                                            
                                        </div>
                                    </listcell>
                                    
                                </listitem>
                            </template>
                            
                        </listbox>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
            
            <!-- SOUTH: Detalle de tarea seleccionada -->
            <south size="200px" border="normal" 
                   title="Detalle de Tarea" 
                   collapsible="true"
                   visible="@load(not empty vm.selectedTask)">
                <vlayout style="padding: 10px;" spacing="5px">
                    <grid>
                        <rows>
                            <row>
                                <label value="ID Tarea:" style="font-weight: bold;"/>
                                <label value="@load(vm.selectedTask.id)"/>
                                <label value="ID Proceso:" style="font-weight: bold;"/>
                                <label value="@load(vm.selectedTask.processInstanceId)"/>
                            </row>
                            <row>
                                <label value="Formulario ZUL:" style="font-weight: bold;"/>
                                <label value="@load(vm.selectedTask.formKey)" style="color: #1976d2;"/>
                                <label value="Owner:" style="font-weight: bold;"/>
                                <label value="@load(vm.selectedTask.owner)"/>
                            </row>
                            <row >
                                <label value="Variables:" style="font-weight: bold;"/>
                                <html content="@load(vm.getTaskVariables(vm.selectedTask))"/>
                            </row>
                        </rows>
                    </grid>
                </vlayout>
            </south>
            
        </borderlayout>
        
    </window>
    
    <!-- DIALOG: Asignar tarea a usuario -->
    <window id="assignDialog" 
            title="Asignar Tarea a Usuario" 
            mode="modal" 
            border="normal" 
            width="500px"
            visible="@load(vm.showAssignDialog)"
            onClose="@command('closeAssignDialog')">
        
        <div style="padding: 15px;">
            
            <label value="@load(vm.taskToAssignTitle)" 
                   style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 14px;"/>
            
            <h:hr />
            
            <div class="d-flex mb-2" style="gap: 10px;">
                <label value="Usuarios disponibles:" class="subtt-mkt"/>
                <label value="@load(concat('(', vm.availableUsers.size(), ' usuarios)'))" 
                       class="txt-mkt"/>
            </div>
            
            <listbox model="@load(vm.availableUsers)" 
                     selectedItem="@bind(vm.selectedUserToAssign)"
                     height="250px">
                <listhead>
                    <listheader label="Usuario" width="150px"/>
                    <listheader label="Nombre Completo" width="200px"/>
                    <listheader label="Email"/>
                </listhead>
                <template name="model" var="user">
                    <listitem>
                        <listcell label="@load(user.username)"/>
                        <listcell label="@load(user.fullname)"/>
                        <listcell label="@load(user.email)"/>
                    </listitem>
                </template>
            </listbox>
            
            <h:hr />
            
            <div class="d-flex justify-content-end" style="gap: 10px;">
                <button label="Cancelar" onClick="@command('closeAssignDialog')" class="btn btn-secondary"/>
                <button label="Asignar" onClick="@command('confirmAssign')" 
                        disabled="@load(empty vm.selectedUserToAssign)"
                        class="btn btn-primary"/>
            </div>
            
        </div>
        
    </div>
    
	</idspace>
</zk>
```

```plaintext
<!-- 
    Bandeja de Tareas BPMN
    
    Funcionalidades:
    - Ver tareas pendientes del usuario logado
    - Ver tareas de sus roles (candidateGroups)
    - Asignar tarea a usuario específico
    - Claim (reclamar) tarea
    - Filtrar por proceso, prioridad, fecha
    - Acceder al formulario ZUL de la tarea
-->
```
