Creando `dashboard.zul` simplificado sin efectos problemáticos:


```plaintext
<?component name="includeHTML" extends="include" class="org.enartframework.zk.utils.IncludeHTML"?>
<?taglib uri="http://www.zkoss.org/dsp/web/core" prefix="c"?>
<zk xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
	xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.zkoss.org/2005/zul/zul.xsd"
	xmlns:h="xhtml">
	<idspace viewModel="@id('vm') @init('com.codeflowx.govern.viewmodel.DashboardViewModel')">
        
        <!-- Header -->
        <div class="row">
            <div class="col-lg-12">
                <div class="left tittle-principal">
                    <h:h2 class="mb-sm-0">Dashboard AI Governance</h:h2>
                    <label value="@load(vm.subtitle)" style="color: var(--second-aux); display: block; margin-top: 8px;"/>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        
        <!-- Métricas principales -->
        <div class="row">
            <div class="col-lg-3 col-md-6 s-bot">
                <div class="card">
                    <div class="card-body">
                        <div class="d-flex align-items-center">
                            <div class="flex-grow-1">
                                <label value="@load(vm.stat1Title)" style="color: var(--second-aux); font-size: 14px; display: block; margin-bottom: 8px;"/>
                                <h:h3 style="margin: 0; font-weight: bold; color: var(--primary-text);">
                                    @load(vm.totalTasks)
                                </h:h3>
                                <label value="@load(vm.stat1Description)" style="color: #3b82f6; font-size: 12px; display: block; margin-top: 4px;"/>
                            </div>
                            <h:i class="fa-duotone fa-tasks" style="font-size: 40px; color: #3b82f6;"></h:i>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <div class="col-lg-3 col-md-6 s-bot">
                <div class="card">
                    <div class="card-body">

                                class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary">

                        </button>
                    </div>
                    <div class="card-body">
                        <grid model="@load(vm.urgentTasks)" 
                              emptyMessage="No hay tareas urgentes">
                            <columns>
                                <column label="Prioridad" width="100px" align="center"/>
                                <column label="Tarea" width="280px"/>
                                <column label="Asignado" width="140px"/>
                                <column label="Roles" width="150px"/>
                                <column label="Vencimiento" width="100px" align="center"/>
                            </columns>
                            <template name="model" var="task">
                                <row style="cursor: pointer;" onClick="@command('openTask', task=task)">
                                    <cell align="center">
                                        <span class="@load(vm.getPriorityBadgeClass(task.priority))" 
                                              style="padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 10px;">
                                            @load(vm.getPriorityText(task.priority))
                                        </span>
                                    </cell>
                                    <cell>
                                        <label value="@load(task.name)" 
                                               style="font-weight: 600; display: block;"/>
                                        <label value="@load(task.description)" 
                                               style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--second-aux);"
                                               visible="@load(not empty task.description)"/>
                                    </cell>
                                    <cell>
                                        <label value="@load(empty task.assignee ? 'Sin asignar' : task.assignee)" 
                                               style="@load(empty task.assignee ? 'color: var(--second-aux);' : 'font-weight: 500;')"/>
                                    </cell>
                                    <cell>
                                        <label value="@load(vm.formatCandidateGroups(task.candidateGroups))" 
                                               style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--second-aux);"/>
                                    </cell>
                                    <cell align="center">
                                        <label value="@load(task.dueDate) @converter('formatedDate', format='dd/MM HH:mm')"
                                               style="color: #dc3545; font-size: 12px;"
                                               visible="@load(not empty task.dueDate)"/>
                                        <label value="Pendiente" 
                                               style="color: var(--second-aux); font-size: 12px;"
                                               visible="@load(empty task.dueDate)"/>
                                    </cell>
                                </row>
                            </template>
```
